title.en: Drives, narrative attractors and the construction of mind

summary.en: A mind is what an environment makes of ancient drive systems: narrative is the drive's interface, stories behave as attractors, optimizing for attention selects the fastest. Most of the psychology has no home: 03's Open names motivation, affect, perception and attention as unreached. Where the account comes near it holds forms on small models, and joining those forms to drives, stories and minds is mostly this crosswalk's proposal, not the account's; agreement with a checked law's form is rare. Live readings that touch the source (one record on its 理 sentence, 02 and 07 on capture) descend from the corpus's own line. Divergences: no closing is called evil, formed is kept from warranted, "truth only intersubjective" and a default purpose are taken otherwise, 心 as root meets a live defeater, a basin's depth and width lie outside the theorems, and a way of seeing alone is scoped.

name.en: Environment makes mind; teaching passes it on

sense.en: Everything a mind holds is constructed, biologically, socially or cognitively; a person is a product of environment, and what makes minds can be given to others, which is teaching. Stated universally, 'you are just mechanical'.

entries.quote: We are all beings within our own environment, and that creates our behaviors, our personalities, the way we think and the way we judge.

reading.en: The account has witnesses and a burden, not the thesis. One finite model: history of development, carrier held the same, gives a different response. Its reading on adult psychology says origin must be told apart among selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission, so "environment" alone is not licensed. For teaching: from its steady state a rule of entry stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure, and a pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing. Reading these as minds is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem on the periphery, a witness: in a finite model two histories with the same carrier, native state and support, differing only in whether developmental sampling came before or after an earlier repair, form different connections; the same carrier and developmental operations do not fix the same response function. Not care in an organism, and no warrant for the response.

The Reading [AI reading, D65] after this result: an inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development; selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission must be told apart where live. An argument, no theorem.

Theorem (root; one family of models): a rule of entry, held by members whose count turns others away, stays held from its steady state exactly where teaching fits a tenure, the quota is at least one and the take fits the renewal: the steady state's law, not the rule's. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation; nothing normative.

Theorem: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (double-negation form); under the passing premise, if passing stops it ends within d steps. Whether carrying forms by passing, or what carrying does to the carriers, is not stated.

Theorem on the periphery, in a declared construction: every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and procedure bit. One finite conditional composition, not the origin of all learning rules or complete cognition.

Theorem on the periphery, all supplied: a practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry installs the context's method in the worker; one connection for one two-method task, not general cognition or the arrival of people.

account_adds.en: That the same mature structure does not identify its formative history; that an evolutionary explanation, normative warrant, recognition and preservation are different achievements; and the exact condition on which a taught rule is held in one model.

source_adds.en: The universal scope (everything a mind holds), the construct-to-model chain from neurons to judgment, and the theses on media and teaching as the actual transmission of whole minds. None is stated of minds. That teaching copies at a fixed factor is explicitly not shown (04, copying).

name.en: Mind and environment make each other; all one

sense.en: Environment shapes you and you shape it. Ren's note: events are made by mind, mind by events and environment, not Kantian dualism but monism, a self-referential loop; if a matter is thoroughly investigated it affects 心 and 理, and if 心 changes 理 and 事 change.

entries.quote: 心为事/环境造，皆是一元也

reading.en: The loop and the monism are live, with limits. A formation's acts return exactly where its loop is closed under affecting, a law; one unfolding is a thesis, argued, not proved; a formation is one law, not a subject facing a world. But "事为心造" taken generally is scoped: 06 says a difference nothing reads remains, so 心 changing does not change every 事. Joining 事为心造 to 06's reading of 心外无事 is mine, and so is reading 心 as a formation. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: two formations lie in one loop where each can affect the other; a formation's acts return, all it acts on lying within what it can represent, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting. Does not show: a formation that affects nothing beyond itself returns trivially.
Thesis, philosophical, argued, not one of T1-T8: there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.
A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world; what it does is part of what goes on.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: "心外无事" as a general claim diverges: a difference nothing reads still stands, carried nowhere.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for acts to return, and that a loop may not be closed.

source_adds.en: The cognitive strong duality of 心, 理 and 事, and self-observation as the route to seeing this (2023-12).

name.en: Ancient drive systems supply motion without direction

source.locator: The argument, first paragraph; claims B.11, K.72-73, K.75

sense.en: SEEKING, RAGE, FEAR, PANIC/GRIEF, CARE, LUST, PLAY, plus STATUS and DISGUST are subcortical, pre-linguistic and mammal-shared; they give energy and urgency and no direction. Each has its own signature, and they yield universal social invariances. Anger and greed narrow what a mind attends to.

entries.quote: they supply energy, not direction, and fire before conscious awareness

reading.en: The account holds no motivational substrate. A target is 'any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled', and its Open lists motivation and affect as unreached. 07 keeps motivation apart: that a loss counts from one's standpoint moves no one by itself. Its word 'seeking' means a run toward a target, not the mesolimbic circuit: same word, other reference. 04 cites care and feeding studies only as constraints on separate links, and its D65 reading has "An inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development". [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The drive taxonomy, each drive's behavioural signature, and the neuroscience. Note that the source attributes most of this to Claude's exposition [C].

name.en: Status and greed have targets that cannot complete

sense.en: STATUS is relative, so its cycle never completes, which makes it the best fuel of a totalizing attractor; SEEKING peaks in approach, not consumption; greed is amplified by purely psychological mechanisms.

entries.quote: inherently relative and therefore never completes its cycle

reading.en: The form of the claim, read off the target and not the circuit: "above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so it cannot rest for two, one alone may, which scopes "never completes"; "more than now" needs change at every step; relative position is zero-sum. And the fuel claim has a reading, by descent from the corpus's line: where winning buys more power to win, targets that cannot rest are taken more and passed on more. The laws do not depend on the source and say nothing of brains. Reading a drive as a target is the join, and is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: under a determined law, seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target; "more than now" needs an open world; "above all others" never holds of two. How a target forms, that a seeker pursues it, and hijacking are not stated. Its reading: dominance as such is not the target ruled out.

Theorem on shares: where carriers leave more offspring, both present, offspring carrying the target (a premise), the share rises. Record's reading (the AI's): hijacking is a target formed and passed on by a selection rewarding what cannot rest, held by a rule its winners write. It derives neither that taking more yields more offspring nor that winners shape the rule.
Theorem by counting: a part's rise against the others is the rest's summed fall, whatever the amounts do. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise, not derived.

Theorem: among two drawers or more in turn, each ranking position, every perfect profile draws everything where what stands from nothing is least; where something left stops what stands next a drawer keeps it. It does not show actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.

account_adds.en: Knowing enough (知足) as a target met at a state the law leaves unchanged [AI reading], the exact boundary; and that runs which keep changing are not locked seeking.

source_adds.en: That status is a distinct circuit, the dopamine asymmetry, and greed's amplification by purely psychological mechanisms. The account's fuel reading is about offspring and rules, not about a cycle that fails to complete in a nervous system.

name.en: Identical surface, different mechanism

sense.en: Status-seeking and individualistic greed can look identical while running on different circuits, so classifying people by surface behaviour is unreliable.

entries.quote: can present identically on the surface while running on different circuits

reading.en: The same obstruction in other pairs: one observed course cannot tell a formation held by its unresolved model from one held by its ranking; choices fix only their shown reach; states can stand apart while acts agree; and 03's Open says similar performance cannot tell conserved, convergent and differently trained solutions apart, a matched test proposed, not performed. The account's pairs are not the source's two circuits; the shape is acts underdetermining what produces them. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem with a witness: formations whose steps keep a relation under which values sensed and acts are one sense and act alike; one unresolved model and one reversed ranking so act alike in one world. Not that a model and an order are never identifiable from acts. Reading: a reason for assistance to read more than acts.
Near-definitional theorem: the positive comparisons every strict order according with the choices shares are exactly the shown reach. It does not show which order an actual chooser carries.
Near-definitional theorem on lumpings. Neither converse holds: occasions differing while their contents agree give states apart and acts alike. Which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.
Open: similar performance cannot tell conserved, convergent and differently trained solutions apart; a matched developmental test is proposed, not performed.

account_adds.en: The exact criterion of what choices fix, and that informing separates the two cases.

source_adds.en: The specific claim about status and greed circuits, and any psychological test for telling them apart.

name.en: Drives in superposition; moods as competing attractors

sense.en: Drives run together rather than as personality types, one dominating being the exception and navigating them what wisdom is. Moods and emotions are competing attractors with stable points and dynamics that actualize when conditions are met, not points on a scale.

entries.quote: one drive dominating is the exception

reading.en: The account has a formal basin but reads no mood or drive on it, and how many basins an actual law has is not shown; its main attraction law is marked "not an attractor in the classical sense". Wisdom there is an open target about the core's common relations, not navigating drives. The source's question 6 says its sense (a) of "attractor" has a phase space and can in principle be measured; its question 7, that the theory has no measurement. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The claim as a whole, and the conjecture that undiscovered attractors exist in a trained system.

entries.quote: regulated by exactly two mechanisms — identification and prediction error

It has a kin of the source's objection that "prediction error" stretches to vacuity: the existence claim forbids nothing alone. That is about persistence, not affect. name.en: The self is the story a mind tells of itself

source.locator: Claims A.6-7; The theory in one paragraph

sense.en: The self is the narrative the mind generates about itself; that narrative constitutes subjectivity and, with more primitive urges, produces particular inclinations to act. What most people take to be phenomenon is their narrative. A person's self is one such attractor. Marked [R].

entries.quote: The self is the narrative the mind generates about itself

reading.en: Both refuse a self with a nature of its own, and there they meet. They part on what stands in its place. The source has a story the mind generates, constituting subjectivity. The account has a center, a formation, and its closure under some relation, with no story in it; the nearest to a story is a represented boundary, whose forming is unmodelled. Identity across steps is one reading of continuation. Which relation draws the self is argued, and the de se question stays open. No law makes a report of oneself constitutive of anything. [AI reading]

says.en: A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation of the unfolding.

The thesis forbids explanations, not observations: one that needs a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value or a self with a nature of its own. Argued; it excludes no observation.
Which formation at one step is which at the next is, on the World model, stipulated by names; identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.
Does not show: that the self is drawn along feeding or need rather than a narrower relation: that reading is argued, and the de se question stays open outside the common closure.

A reading (the AI's), of Ren's words on the self's "imagined boundary" as cognitive construct: a region of conditions reads as the boundary a center represents; it can cover what the center requires and not what it takes part in, or omit what it requires. Nothing models how a center forms or represents a boundary.

Correspondence: Ren wrote the self is "a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of 'belief'". The reading (an AI argument): the presupposition reads that belief; using it as a premise is the AI's step. The condition fixes scope and C order, neither asserted.

account_adds.en: A self stated by closure, so how far it reaches is a question about a relation and not about a story.

source_adds.en: The self as narrative, its constituting subjectivity, and its generating inclinations with the primitive urges. Neither says which is right: the source's claim is about minds, on one conversation; the account's is a choice of representation, argued.

name.en: Stories are selected for spreading, not for truth

source.locator: Genealogy 2024-06; 'What earlier versions had', item i; own words 10

sense.en: Ren's 2024 text: each narrative has its way of making believe; those fit to spread in the environment spread, fear and anger often fittest. Actors can design this for selfish capture. Good narratives happen, but are usually less fit than those not matching reality. A plain statement the source says was later lost.

entries.quote: Good narratives, also happens often, but they are usually not evolutionarily fit as the ones that don't match reality

reading.en: The form, without stories: a selection reaches exactly what couples into its selector, so where truth does not couple into spread, spread does not select it; a share rises with differential offspring and transmission; and "a successful proxy does not make a representation true". A belief's spread has only a witness with supplied laws, nothing specific to belief. Whether fear is fitter is not stated. Reading spread as such a selector is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem on the World: every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them; the law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector.
Theorem on shares: where carriers leave more offspring and offspring carry the target (a premise), the share rises. Not that taking more yields more offspring.
The Reading after it [AI reading, D65]: a successful proxy does not make a representation true.
A belief whose rate of spread grows with its number: the laws of spread and of the rate's change are fixed, and nothing here is specific to belief; closed capture is the nearer model.
Open: a belief system whose content or law of spread changes.

account_adds.en: That truth's absence from what selects is one condition among couplings, not a fact about stories.

source_adds.en: That fear- and anger-igniting stories are fitter, that good stories are usually less fit, deliberate design for capture, and the media mechanism. Also held in selfishness-spiral-and-narrative-value-frames.

name.en: A story as an input channel that bypasses evaluation

source.locator: Claim D.29; The argument, 'Narrative is the interface'

sense.en: Marked [C] in the source. Narrative is a legitimate input channel to the drive system; drive-activating stories skip the evaluation explicit arguments get. A storyteller has direct access to another's drive architecture, which is why propaganda works on intelligent people.

entries.quote: drive-activating narratives bypass the prefrontal evaluation that explicit arguments receive

reading.en: A word search misses this. The account separates a demonstration, which filters what a reader tells apart, from a presented input that revises its valuation, a supplied update, each moving the answer the other leaves, and the record cannot always show which happened. That is the channel's form in one decision. Reading it as story or propaganda is mine; nothing is said of minds or of bypass. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, compositions in counts, none claimed new, one decision, the reading formation's update as supplied: a demonstration filters the listing, an input presented revises the valuation; in witnesses each turns an answer the other leaves; across two starts, a case of one start not reached, answers and final state do not determine whether the valuation changed. Reading: no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied.

account_adds.en: The exact criterion of when revaluing lowers the worth of holding for an answer, and that with a shared model there is no reason by the current valuation to revise it; related to Bayesian persuasion and induced preference shifts.

source_adds.en: Neural bypass of evaluation, the claim that stories in particular reach drives, and the political use. Nearer still and not live, history/VALUATION-DEVELOPMENT.md: consequence-driven valuation can be captured wherever its activity reaches a signal decoupled from the conditions of its continuation, proved possibilities, not a necessity; and changed choice is not, by itself, changed valuation.

name.en: The mind defends the story rather than updating it

sense.en: Marked [C]; own words 12 are Ren's. The self-narrative biases which drives are expressed; because coherence is itself a need, a mind under contradiction defends its story. The self without a better model keeps the one that feels right. So behaviour change is more often story change than incentive change.

entries.quote: the mind under contradiction defends the story rather than updating it

reading.en: Two pieces with no drive of coherence behind them. A model is revised only by what its own course exposes, so it can rest unrefuted. And locked seeking forms when a habit or identity becomes the fixed measure of later cases, a label usable only from what is actually excluded before assessment. A reading kept by its own update is not thereby informative, and firm belief alone is no sign. The source's motive is absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem with witnesses: where the world answers the act chosen and every listed candidate predicts it, the formation rests at once on a model its course never refutes. Reading: related to self-confirming equilibrium; what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection. That actual learners keep candidates by elimination is not shown.

The Reading on obscuration and reopening [AI reading, D65] following the seeking laws: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases; diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment.
Theorem, near-definitional: being kept is not being informative: the readings of every world and of none are kept by every update. That an actual formation keeps the reading stated is not shown.

account_adds.en: That a model need make no error of motive to go unrefuted: choosing through it suffices. Reopening is a blocked relation regaining effect, not an apology or a renamed goal. How candidates come to be proposed, the "better model" of Ren's sentence, is outside the law.

source_adds.en: Narrative coherence as a need, fragmentation as aversive, and the empirical claim about story change against incentive change.

name.en: Every model is an adaptation to a local environment

sense.en: What matters is not whether my model works but whether we have adequate models. Every model integrated into a psyche is an adaptation to its local environment, and may not apply as the environment grows more complex: the cognitive lag.

entries.quote: they are inevitably only an adaptation of our local environment

reading.en: Stated exactly, in pieces. A fit through a lumping is right at a new input exactly where the world repeats the observed value there; that names when a local adaptation carries. A calibration is defeated by later change of the channels. And what is right along a course can be wrong off it, untested. The account gives conditions and no claim that complexity outruns minds. Reading "local adaptation" as these is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: for functions alike across a lumping, data fix the value at an input lumped with an observed one; a fit is right there exactly where the world repeats the observed value. Which lumping an actual formation imposes is not derived.

Theorem on the periphery: for affine channels readings at two references recover the report of success; one reference, mixed epochs and later change fail. A change of the channels after a calibration defeats the report.

Theorem on a blanketed law: two worlds give one sensed course exactly as long as they answer alike what the formation does. Related to self-confirming equilibrium; none of those theorems is reproduced.

account_adds.en: Exactly when a fit carries to a new case, and that correction and calibration are different achievements.

source_adds.en: The cognitive-lag conclusion for a society growing more complex, and that this is the reason the self holds its model.

name.en: Narrative attractors have basins of depth and width

sense.en: Marked [C]. A story that captures trajectories has a basin depth, width, boundary topology and dimensionality. The source itself warns "attractor" runs in four senses and that the theory has no measurement: depth and width are stated as if quantifiable and none is operationalized.

entries.quote: Narrative attractors have geometry

reading.en: The account takes up basins and puts what the source names outside them. Its basins are classes of courses that meet, on any determined law; being drawn in is exactly not returning, "not an attractor in the classical sense"; and the record says how deep or wide a basin is lies outside the theorems. No state space of stories is named. One neighbour for depth: in one drawn model, the bound on leaving a lock falls across the distance from the critical mass. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem for every determined law: a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return. Near-definitional, "not an attractor in the classical sense". Does not show: which regions actual unfoldings enter, and how deep or wide a basin is, lie outside the theorems.

Theorem: courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m, and each basin holds one cycle. How many basins an actual law has is not shown.

Theorem on counts: drawn one member at a time, the stag hunt of shapers and readers drawn from the selected leaves either lock by drift, at a weight whose bound falls across the distance from the critical mass. One model of shapers and readers, not of stories.

meta-attractor (元吸引子): closed capture. It never means the corpus's working definition, a recurrent organization of activity reproducing the conditions selecting it across changes in its carriers: that sense is wider, and the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers.

account_adds.en: That being drawn in and failing to return are one condition; a returning region is itself absorbing, so closing in form is no loss.

source_adds.en: Basin width, fractal boundaries and dimension, depth as a measured quantity, and the reading of stories as such attractors. Strange attractors are outside a finite determined law's cycle.

name.en: An ecology of narratives

sense.en: Marked [C], with historical illustrations. Narratives exclude each other within a niche, parasitize deeper hosts, and include keystones whose loss reorganizes others. New ones nucleate at the seam of two incompatible ones; old ones hold while their boundary erodes, then release many trajectories at once. Biology, medium and social structure shape the landscape.

entries.quote: keystone attractors whose loss reorganizes the whole downstream ecosystem

reading.en: Forms exist for dependences, not stories; reading stories as such formations is mine, untested. Exclusion in a niche: full taking alongside another taker ends every formation depending at the need. Keystone: along chains of total dependence with positive draws one end ends everything downstream; the law says ends, the source reorganizes. Erosion then release: coupled by threshold, how far off the break is does not couple in. And passages come in kinds, not one "phase transition". [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: full taking alongside another taker ends every formation depending at the need; the exclusion acts through the taking, not the levels. How taking all forms is not stated, and the excluding and the sharing course are not ranked.

Theorem: along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all, and a draw of nothing stops the cascade. Partial dependence is not covered; how far it reaches in a field web is untested.

Theorem: where a stock couples by threshold only, how far off the break is does not couple in; coupled by level, every raise passes at once. A runaway remains a reading; that a formation draws more than is renewed is not derived.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: a region ceasing, a state's departure and a strict bifurcation are not one "phase transition"; passages come by parameter change, shock, failure of what executes correction, or change faster than correction.

account_adds.en: The exact premises of each form, and that a passage has several kinds to be told apart.

source_adds.en: Nucleation at seams, parasitic riding on deeper hosts, the medium as shaping nucleation time and lifespan, and that some attractors do not exist as stable states under some institutions, all as claims about stories.

name.en: Counter-narrative fails; a lateral shift escapes

sense.en: Efficient manipulation reroutes a running trajectory into another basin rather than build one. Pure counter-narrative almost never frees anyone; what works is shifting attention to a dimension of experience half-sensed and not yet narrativized, as good psychotherapy does.

entries.quote: pure counter-narrative fails because a trajectory cannot be pushed into a vacuum

reading.en: Structural neighbour, under named premises: where the next configuration depends on the rule, perturbing the state is re-absorbed; what leaves is a change of law, of how the rule reads, or of selection. 02's D26 reading names 明, coupling joined to the selection so that it reaches what the share does not carry. A reversal held past a threshold is not absorbed, so "almost never" is scoped. Reading story as state and a new dimension as a new reading is mine. The record's "hijacking" is another thing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step. Shown only under that premise, "a strong condition".

Theorems: a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves; one reversing the direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed. That actual rules read the share is the premise. Reading [D26]: what leaves is 明, coupling joined to the selection so that it reaches what the share does not carry.
Theorem: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out, not shown the only one (T7).

account_adds.en: When a change is absorbed and when not, by exact criteria; and a frozen test (LA2) in one trained system where one note of a loss turned the judge and the pool-of-readers conjecture failed for that judge.

source_adds.en: Hijacking as rerouting a running trajectory, attention to a half-sensed dimension, and the therapeutic claim. None is stated. The source's link to the Fork as a branch point is not taken up here.

name.en: Believed survival pressure deepens every basin

sense.en: Ren's own contribution: the attractor of attractors is believing one is under survival pressure. It deepens every other basin, opens populations to rhetoric of bigness (and, on Alex's claim with Ren's reply, to attachment to power), and makes totalization conditional on a belief rather than a fact, hence actionable, and a reason the provision floor comes first.

entries.quote: A culture that believes itself to be in a survival state will totalize almost any attractor it holds.

reading.en: A central claim of the folder, and I find no home. Word trap: the account's meta-attractor is closed capture, a different thing from this. Nearby and not it: a weighting falling faster than renewal ends the base, reading a short horizon, with no belief; a prediction read by its response is about publication, not perceived threat; basic-condition priority is "defended by non-substitution", not by loosening rhetoric's grip; 05 says its constraints are not survival axioms. No law makes capture depend on a perceived state. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The thesis and its political consequence. It could fail: a test would compare totalization against perceived and actual scarcity, not designed here or in the source.

searched: survival, scarc*, threat, fear, perception of, belief, believ*, rhetoric, bread, provision floor
read: 01-ROOT.md witness "a belief whose rate of spread grows with its number"

name.en: Belief in the dynamic produces the dynamic

sense.en: Certainty that everyone will defect is itself cult dynamics, 'a form of extremism', and produces the reality it predicts.

entries.quote: Belief in the dynamic is what makes the dynamic

reading.en: 03 reads self-fulfilling prophecy, with conditions. A public prediction read by what it predicts: under a threshold response two are right, and where publication starts decides which is reached. Where the rest alone outrun the renewal, a member's restraint selects nothing, yet depletion need not be the only equilibrium. And 05 reads "others will deceive me, so I deceive first" as withholding with memory, which absorbs: there the law of giving does it, no belief needed. Nothing calls the belief extremism. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, near-definitional, with a general law: a published prediction read by the response is right exactly where the response to it is itself; in a witness a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts. Reading [AI reading, new]: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy (Merton 1948): a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts; the witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.

Theorem on the World: where the rest alone take more than a gated renewal gives, the condition ends whatever a member takes, and no weight on a reading from the rest's end on selects the member's restraint. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium; what learners reach is tested, not a theorem.

Theorem: with memory, a formation gives at step n exactly where every formation within n waits of it gave at the start, so a withholding stays and spreads downstream; one withholding, every formation within d waits of it, ends all giving from step d on. Reading [D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Not that cooperation is good.

account_adds.en: That a response moving every value has no right prediction, so not every belief can make itself true; the least right prediction reached from below; and that the same absorbing can arise with no belief in it.

source_adds.en: That this describes competition's actual belief, and the charge of cult dynamics, which is a verdict the account does not make.

name.en: Optimizing engagement collapses what can exist

sense.en: Engagement optimization projects a high-dimensional behaviour space onto what it reads; structures that need long unfolding do not weaken, they cease to exist. So unfragmented time and real relation are infrastructure, and today's dominant attractors are primitive products of algorithmic profit.

entries.quote: attractors requiring long temporal unfolding do not weaken, they cease to exist as attractors

reading.en: Three kin, narrower than the claim. A selection reaches exactly what couples into its selector. An optimum drains what lies beyond its couplings where there is room, to the least level, breaking exactly the dependences some eligible outcome breaks: that much of "cease, not weaken" has form. A weighting faster than renewal ends the stock at once. All concern stocks; proved for optima, conjectured for trained systems. Reading meaning so is mine. A loss needs the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem on the World: every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them; with the rest fixed it is blind beyond the coupling closure. The law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector.

Theorem: every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond, condition by condition, exactly where no eligible outcome standing above another there goes unbeaten on the family; with room, optima break exactly the dependences beyond that some eligible outcome breaks.

Theorem: under a weighting falling faster than renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal. No evaluation enters: not that a weighting ought to be flatter or a base kept.

Thesis T3: optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings, where that gives room. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, with partial support; LA4's Stage A, on small policies trained by gradient, finds the drain rising with nearness and leaves its locus unresolved.

Theorem on the periphery, in the market model: a share of none stays none (a witness): selection does not create an absent practice. Reading [D65] after it: a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks; a real loss need not form a meta-attractor; attraction is not continuation.

Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from.

account_adds.en: The condition of room, forbidden cases that could refute it, and a set point under which what is counted after is kept. That the wider is better needs a premise (ONE-PAGE), so "collapse" is not a verdict here. And a real loss need not form a meta-attractor: a lost capacity needs actual entry to return.

source_adds.en: Temporal unfolding as the mark of what is lost, human meaning as the dimensions, unfragmented time and real relation as infrastructure, and attribution of present culture to algorithms. A short-form media test is not designed.

name.en: Fast activation beats slow understanding

sense.en: Primitive attractors activate in milliseconds, complex ones in seconds to minutes, so an environment rewarding fast activation is a selection biased toward the primitive; moved to power, compounding that forces everyone to run faster selects against deliberative decision models, more strongly where power iterates faster (a conjecture).

entries.quote: so an attention-optimized environment is a selection environment structurally biased toward the primitive

reading.en: The account's fast and slow are two levels of one course, and that a layered pace is better than another is not shown. Its selection laws read shares and offspring, with no term for how soon a competitor activates. Lateness bears on correction: a late regulator needs a wider band, a reading turns a lock only inside a window. Nearest to the source's "first ten metres": where the start decides a lock (D45), and rewarding those who break the routes of correction (D26). Neither is a contest won by arriving first. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The rate thesis at both scales. The rate claim stands in meta-attractor, not live.

searched: faster, iterat, tempo, pace, layered, rate, speed, fast step, millisecond, deliberat*, outrun, lock-in, increasing returns
read: records how-fast-a-rule-may-change (statement and does_not_show), two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading, loss-read-in-time-by-the-others, becoming-finite-horizon (statements)

name.en: What makes a basin inescapable

sense.en: Marked [C]. Six patterns, none totalizing alone: drive coupling, resolution deferral, identity fusion, social proof closure, exit cost escalation, and deepest, attractor-generated epistemology, where the attractor supplies the method by which it would be assessed.

entries.quote: the attractor supplying the method, not the conclusions

reading.en: Three of the six have a form. Attractor-generated epistemology: a reading itself formed from the share absorbs any change of reading. Social proof closure: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach, and selection through later copiers runs through those before them; a rule read as the pool drawn from those it selects. Identity fusion: a habit or identity become the fixed measure of later cases, refusal read as resistance. Resolution deferral resembles a target unmet at rest, my reading. Each rests on named premises; whether minds meet them is kept apart. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: where neither next share nor rule read reads the beyond, the lock outlives the loss; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem: with readers counted as the population counts them, the rule read is a monotone function of the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'; a loss read only by the others keeps the lock exactly where carriers are at least as many when it is read.
Theorem: a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

Theorem, near-definitional: where every member from k on acts alike whatever its own coupling, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k, however many follow. It does not show when an actual member stops reading its own coupling. Reading [D45]: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach.

The Reading [AI reading, D65] after these laws: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost; diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment.

account_adds.en: That the timing of a reading of the loss decides; that T7 is about courses where drift rarely leaves the lock; and a frozen test (LA2): with one trained judge, one note of the loss among nine turned it and the pool-of-readers conjecture failed there, the law standing within its hypotheses.

source_adds.en: Drive coupling and exit cost escalation as named mechanisms, the threat-response of identity fusion, and that none alone suffices. Near exit cost only: a reading that a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise, and a bound on leaving that falls across the distance from the mass.

name.en: The captured mind: Moloch in miniature

sense.en: [AI-doc, with R] Under the totalizing dynamic feeling becomes sovereign, reason serves existing wants, drives become identity, and the shared world for arguing the good disappears. The dynamic manufactures the minds that find it obvious, so structural reform alone does not reach cognition; the worshipper is Moloch in miniature. "Not about any person. Structural."

entries.quote: the loop closes at the level of persons

reading.en: The loop has a home, by descent, for 02's D26 reads the corpus's own meta-attractor: winners forming the minds that read the scorecard is `ReadsShare` on the reading. And "structural reform alone" has a form: a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed, a change of reading too where formed from the share. But readers being minds stays a reading, and the verdict is refused: none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生. At one person the nearest law is a counted lock, not the meta-attractor, its score standing. The source's disease is not asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: With the Reading on the corpus's meta-attractor [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners writing the scorecard is ReadsShare, winners forming the minds that read it is ReadsShare on the reading; that readers are minds is a reading; none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

Theorem on counts: a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices, under a standing score, never leaves the region its threshold sets, even against its score. Reading [D45]: it is capture through the rule; its score stands, so it is not the meta-attractor, whose reading too is formed from the share. No probability or free energy.

Thesis T7: a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation; in the model only invariance under the unread and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved, without noise. That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.

account_adds.en: That the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours; that the same form holds whichever direction a loop locks; and, beside the source's "not about any person", that whose losses count is asked apart from blame (07's crux, argued, not proved).

source_adds.en: The phenomenology (feeling promoted, introspection as strategy, loss of the shared world), that reason's oldest function is correcting desire, and the capture as a disease. None is named in the live text.

name.en: The political claim is epistemic before institutional

source.locator: Claim H.56; 'The intervention target follows'; own words 48-49; Genealogy 2024-10

sense.en: The root causes are in our thinking; the most fundamental substrate of society is how we see things and choose; "the minds are trapped". So the object of intervention is the mind, and the foundation is a way of seeing, a meta layer above perception and choice. The source's own paragraph pulls the other way: "the environment is the intervention surface".

entries.quote: right now the minds are trapped, let's set the foundation - where we think beyond these logic

reading.en: The account agrees a way out must change what is read, and locates it elsewhere than minds: a change of law, of how the rule reads, or of selection; 明 is coupling joined to the selection. That a reading is a mind is itself a reading; a reform of the reading alone does not outlast the next reading. T3 forbids an instruction keeping a dependent uncoupled; T4 found no told scope keeping an untold one; 07 says seeing is not valuing. So a way of seeing alone is scoped, on those systems. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed; what leaves is a change of the law, such as a reading of what lies beyond the share. Reading: that readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading.

Thesis T7 forbids, among others, a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading. Only invariance under the unread and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.
Theorem: a reading while the others' late reading a step on still favours them turns the course; once it would favour the shapers the lock stays; a deadline bounds the window.

T3 forbids, with couplings fixed: an instruction that does not bring a dependent into what the learners couple into, yet keeps it more often than the same learners without the instruction. The clause on trained systems is conjectured.

Thesis T4: an AI system told the scope abstractly keeps a dependent wherever three couplings hold at once. IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two); no condition kept an untold dependent; transfer untested. T4 tests installing the scope, which the continuation condition fixes; C gives order; neither is asserted, their warrant open.

Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

account_adds.en: That a reading is timed, and that its effect runs through couplings; both are stated for models and one test on trained systems, not for societies.

source_adds.en: The priority of the epistemic over the institutional, and that a meta layer of seeing is the fundamental substrate. On people the account has no test.

name.en: Channel the drives; the disease is foreclosure

sense.en: Drives are ancient and a primary cause of civilizational failure when positive feedback runs unchecked. So design channels them toward harmony and never flattens hierarchy; some hierarchies bring peace. The disease is foreclosure, not strength.

entries.quote: the disease is foreclosure, not strength or hierarchy as such

reading.en: The account keeps the structure and withholds the ruling. A closing is mapped by form; whether it supports or damages 生生 is left to comparison, with the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted and warrant open. So "foreclosure is the disease" is conditional here, and "harmony" reads nothing named. "Unchecked feedback breaks a system" has form with scope: a loop of recurring couplings need not run away. On hierarchy 06 records a layer of contest and rank, its difference one of direction, and gives no sign to it. [AI reading]

says.en: The mechanism: earlier texts wrote evaluation into definitions (成闭为恶); here only structure is mapped; whether a closing supports or damages 生生 is said by comparison, the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: the forming of concern has several entrances (extending existing response, relational practice, institutional coordination, shaping incentives), to be tested side by side; putting the goal into reward or “天然善” does not yet explain it.

Reading of four non-relational layers: 争胜与等级 (二柄, 民弱国强, 贵贱有等, 亲亲之杀) sets a direction within relations, not a prior entity, so its divergence is in direction. Witnesses: a rise needs a fall; an imposed code makes all agree, each losing what it merges.

Theorem on the World: each return at least doubles what reached it, so frequent returns outgrow every polynomial, while a self-loop coupling at sparse steps recurs yet stays polynomial; a loop of recurring couplings does not imply runaway.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: an exchange of harms is a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind.

account_adds.en: That keeping and losing at a juncture are one operation with no valuation, and that a limit is told apart by what it does to what can be had again, not by its name.

source_adds.en: That drives can be channelled, by what, that human nature is a primary cause of civilizational failure, and that some hierarchies bring peace: the account compares no hierarchy as better or worse without a premise.

name.en: Fixed payoffs rebuild Moloch; virtue does not self-install

sense.en: Fixing payoffs without cultivating drives lets the dynamic rebuild inside the garden, a red team's charge, conceded. The classical continuation is 修身 and 礼: "a civilization is grown, not only engineered". The source admits no mechanism is given for how a civilization cultivates. Marked [R], a value stance.

entries.quote: fixing payoffs without cultivating drives lets Moloch rebuild inside the garden

reading.en: Two forms of rebuilding, neither of cultivation. A counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; and from a start against its reading it may never lock, which scopes "rebuild". 07 reads the imperial examination so, as read in the meta-attractor line: by descent, not independent; the capture laws stand apart. And a rule of entry stays held from its steady state only while members teach within a tenure: no holder stays no holder under the whole net. So a fixed rule's lasting depends on its rebuilding, which has a form. Reading that rebuilding as 修身 or 礼 is not given. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did, and only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long; the imperial examination is this case, as read in the meta-attractor line. From a start against its reading it may never lock. It rests on the capture laws.

Theorem (root; one family of models): from its steady state a rule of entry stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure; taught by members or not at all, no holder stays no holder under the whole net. Does not show: why a teacher turns anyone away; holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation; nothing normative.

account_adds.en: The exact condition under which a rule outlasts its holders in one model, and that a counter-rule's lock is a matter of how it reads, not of its intent.

source_adds.en: Cultivating drives, which is the claim, 修身 and 礼 as mechanism, and the willingness to give up the thrill of winning. The source gives no mechanism, and the account's model says why a member teaches at all is not modelled.

name.en: 理 regulates 心 against runaway

source.locator: Claims M.84-87; 'The regulator, named'; Open questions 16-17

sense.en: 心 and 理, feeling and reason, are not opposed: they are one dynamic, 心理, neither dominant. Reason regulates the heart's positive feedback so it does not run away; balance is the aim; the good side is innate and needs shaping. The source asks who forms the regulator. The talk is translated and not confirmed by ear.

entries.quote: 有的时候，即使心所向往的是那样，我们依然要通过理性加以调节，不能让正反馈循环失控

reading.en: The account reads this very sentence, so by descent: a record's reading, the AI's on delegation, takes Ren's words of 4 October onto runaway, a loop through whose couplings, before the break, the world is alike with one holding as much more stock as one likes; avoiding it needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings. That is regulation by what the loop lacks, not reason correcting desire, and need not be inside. 06 reads 心即理 as the responsive side of a relation; ethical recognition does not follow from the other corrections. Joins are mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem on the World, near-definitional: a policy through the couplings, the rest fixed, that keeps its support leaves unused a larger stock coupled in by threshold only; how far off the break is does not couple in. A runaway remains a reading; where the stock is observed a break can often be seen coming. Record's reading (the AI's, on delegation): avoiding it needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings; this reads Ren's words of 4 October.

Theorem: where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less; with whole-number factors it closes at once, keeps, or exceeds every bound. Not that closing is better than keeping or widening.
Reading [AI reading, new]: what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.

Theorem on the World: opposed from both sides within its gap, exactly not overshooting, a level settles at m; read l steps late, every rule needs a band at least 2(l+1)d wide. Which level is regulated, and that holding one is good, are not said. Reading passages such as 中节 as these laws is the AI's.
§6 opening: a model of what is irrelevant is a lumping; 理, the modeling of the laws of structure and change, is one notion, because a model of change is a lumping the step goes alike across.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: 心即理, in context, is the responsive side within a relation, not an ontology of 心. Situations bring three corrections: of means, of the specific aim, of basic ethical recognition; the third does not follow from the first two. Skilled control can still lack 仁.

With the reference the reading formation's current valuation and a shared model, no rule stands higher than its answer, and a revaluation lowers it exactly where it decides a listed cell against the current strict preference. One decision, in counts.

account_adds.en: The exact bound of a regulation that does not overshoot, what lateness costs it, and, for one decision in counts, an obstruction to a revision judged by the reading formation's current valuation. Question 17 meets a partial form: what tells worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection. And a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less, with no sign of good.

source_adds.en: The regulator inside a person, reason correcting desire, the reading of 心理 as 心 and 理, the claim that the good side is innate, and a feedback pair taken between the 程朱 and 陆王 poles.

name.en: 逍遥 as a model that fits, and no independent self

sense.en: When one's cognitive model fits reality one is nearer 逍遥, and there is no independent self. The assistant's reading in the source, marked conjecture: the joint quiet of low prediction error and loosened identification, testable by practices doing one without the other.

entries.quote: 如果你当下的认知模型与现实相契合，那就更接近一种“逍遥”的状态

reading.en: The account takes up the self and its boundary and says otherwise. 08 forbids an explanation needing a self with a nature of its own, near the source's 'no independent self', yet 01 keeps boundaries: one short of the whole is real, relative to its relation, so a fitted model keeps its boundary. Quiet as evidence of fit meets a law: a formation can rest on a model its course never refutes, wrong off that course, so no error from inside does not tell fit from an untested model; that application is this read's. 逍遥 as a state has no home. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Two live arguments would defeat it: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

Theorem (any types; a witness): where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the formation rests at once on a model its course never refutes. Reading [AI]: a model right along its course and wrong off it, related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993); what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection.

source_adds.en: 逍遥 as a state; what fit is like from inside; the source's conjecture of a joint quiet of low prediction error and loosened identification, testable by practices doing one without the other.

name.en: Construction against selection of minds

sense.en: 'The environment constructs the mind' and 'selects among minds' are different mechanisms needing different interventions, used side by side unmarked. Old traditions formed character; the present power system rewards and filters the opposite. The sequence, and tempo as weight, are the assistant's composition.

entries.quote: Selection versus construction is not distinguished.

reading.en: The account marks the difference twice. It reads training as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates, and D65 has consequences select what learns, with gradient training, reproduction and institutional evaluation as different mechanisms; that narrows the gap, in my reading. Yet in the market model a share of none stays none: selection does not create an absent practice, and entry is further. So selection needs what it selects supplied, which keeps the source's different interventions. No law composes the two; that a layered pace is better is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem on the periphery, in the market model: a share of none stays none (a witness): selection does not create an absent practice. Reading [D65] after it: a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.

The Reading after it [AI reading, D65], an argument, not a theorem: effects of activity change which relations are formed, kept or replaced; gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation are different mechanisms of it; unconditional convergence toward renewal is not established.
Theorem on the World: training read as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them.
Among carriers: where carriers leave more offspring, both present, and offspring carry the target (a premise), the share rises. The selection term of Price's equation, not a new law.

account_adds.en: That learning and differential reproduction can be stated in one selection form with different mechanisms; the regulation, learning, meta-learning and reflective inquiry classification is functional (D65).

source_adds.en: The composition rule (construction sets the distribution, selection filters, tempo weights), the character claim about old traditions, and the proposed field test.

name.en: What has value is a construct of environment

source.locator: Genealogy 2025 (the construction paragraph); claims A.1-2; L.80

sense.en: Environment constructs the image of the subject and what it should do, what has value and which value ranks higher. Drives get direction from narrative. Knowing this liberates: what is formed can be changed, and that gives the ability to be who you want to become.

entries.quote: constructed images of the subject and defined what it should do, what has value, and what value is more important than other values.

reading.en: Standards form within the unfolding and none outside owns value: this much is live. But the account splits what the source runs together: gaining influence, recognizing a target, warrant and being followed are four questions; coming to care can recognize a prior reason and create new ones; learning a disposition is not learning a reason; later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. So 'formed, so changeable' is kept, and becoming who one wants gets no warrant from being formed. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value. Influence, recognition, warrant and being followed are four questions; a standard can be wrong, and learning a disposition is not learning a reason. Reading [D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.

Theorem: a statement reading only the dynamics, holding with some significance, also holds with a rival bounded by a region; one entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. A fact about the representation, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

name.en: Refusing obedience to one's own drive architecture

source.locator: Own words 15; Open question 9; Genealogy 2026-02 to 03

sense.en: The source's ethical hinge: Ren refuses to anchor on drives or on self-interest. He is part of the universe, and his purpose exists to make more possibilities and to keep totalizing attractors from erasing them, which 'is just what should be pursued'. The source says this needs a place to stand that is not itself constructed, and has never said what that is.

entries.quote: Why do I have to satisfy my own drive architecture and be obedient to it?

reading.en: Live in T8, with the status changed. The account compares by widening under two premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open, and no verdict binding every possible mind. Where the source says "just what should be pursued", the account says a ranking needs C or a premise in its place. The place to stand that question 9 seeks is refused as an outside, on a thesis argued. "Part of the universe" meets the crux: are one's effects one's own, argued, not proved. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T8: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). It starts from what acting presupposes, not from a wish that life go on. Argued; no verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.
§4.7, an AI reading throughout, argued, not proved: are one's effects one's own? ONE-PAGE adds: drawing the self so wide may only redefine it, one objection of several.

Theorem: along a relation, the presupposition sub-true is significance over the closure, super-true it is the condition; along the empty relation sub-truth is a standpoint's own good, along the total relation the condition.

On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value. Whether a standard so formed gains influence, recognizes its target, has warrant or is followed are four questions.

account_adds.en: That a statement reading only the dynamics also holds with a rival bounded by a region, so what separates the refusal from its rival is a premise, argued; and that a perspectivist denies the condition consistently.

source_adds.en: The first-person refusal itself, the question of what stands outside construction, and 'part of the universe' as settled grounds rather than as the argued crux.

name.en: A self-interest axiom gives cyberpunk whatever the content

entries.quote: If the meta layer retains the self-interest axiom, the output is cyberpunk regardless of content

So "regardless of content" is scoped: it depends on what one's own continuation holds, and where a course keeps something beyond, some such order reverses. Other rankings still need C for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted. [AI reading]

Theorem on the World: formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; under the gate at need m, n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m leave the level below m for good and end every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m.

account_adds.en: The exact case where self-concern alone ranks, on the World's premises, and that in a mutually fed flow placing the premise more narrowly is not warranted.

name.en: A self as a by-product of keeping a goal

source.locator: Claims I.59-60; Open question 5; 'Where this becomes machine design'

sense.en: Goals need continuity, which needs a carrier, a boundary, then defence, then antagonism: an eight-step chain, corpus-independent, so 'a strong agent with no self' is not on the menu. A functional Ego has six observable components, without any claim of inner experience. A review inside the corpus asks to weaken this to convergence risk.

entries.quote: Ego is a by-product of goal maintenance

reading.en: The account takes up the incentive and gives it conditions, not necessity: a route of keeping stands above a revision only where the law's later acting has a value and the route keeps it more surely, or loses less, with exact exits. Complying when read and acting otherwise when not is uniquely best only under a stated threshold. A pattern can outlast brief carriers through passing, so "the carrier must persist" is scoped. No self-boundary chain is derived. This supports the corpus's own reviewer (question 5). [AI reading]

Whether a revision is better is the ethics', under the condition for scope and C for order.

Theorem in two stages: complying when read and acting by its own law when not stands above every other plan exactly where k_O V + c T < k_C V. Reading: at most an incentive, not deception in full; a recipient's belief and an intention are not represented.

Theorem: a pattern present from T on whose carriers are brief for d lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (in double-negation form); under the passing premise if passing stops it ends within d steps.

Theorem on the World: over a region covering what a formation requires it keeps its own support and can undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its support. How a center forms or represents a region is unmodelled.

account_adds.en: Thresholds that make the incentive vanish; and that reading the prospects as a formation's own is a reading.

In a code, the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use, and hearing makes no form, which is near "what can be imagined". T4 tests a told scope: it kept a seen dependent for one model of two, and no condition kept an untold one. The word "repertoire" in 03 is a supplied list of meanings, a different thing. [AI reading]

Near-definitional theorem: where no read occasion is tied to an occasion, every value there is taken by a selected law agreeing on every reading. Which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.

Thesis T4: an AI system told the scope abstractly keeps a dependent with no seat at a rate its community's goal does not reach wherever three couplings hold at once. Standing: IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two); transfer untested; no condition kept an untold dependent. T4 tests installing the scope, which the continuation condition fixes; C gives order; neither is asserted, their warrant open.

account_adds.en: An exact bound on what any selection through courses can fix, and a frozen test of one instruction on two models. What a corpus does to strategies has to come from outside these laws.

name.en: Truth only in intersubjective reality

sense.en: Truth is found only intersubjectively, never in 'what is'. Agreement across subjects raises confidence, which licenses building structures, and reality's response feeds back. An organism perceives according to its own modelling system.

name.en: 心 as a fourth irreducible root

name.en: Is the framework itself a basin?

sense.en: Naming the mechanisms may be another explanatory capture, a framework that explains everything becoming its own totalizing basin. Posed by Claude, unanswered by Ren; this theory has more exposure than any other, since its subject is what an explanation does to a mind.

entries.quote: where having a framework that explains everything becomes its own totalizing basin

reading.en: The charge is against the account's own form, and is kept as a test. A root law forbids no relation; content comes through hypotheses. The thesis of one unfolding excludes no observation, and as a language nothing defeats it. So at the root the charge's premise is conceded, and moved to what hypotheses forbid. No check inside shows the work serves its purpose. 07 says that without substantive disagreement with no closure, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples. Whether the account is a basin is not settled by saying so. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.
By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation; it forbids explanations, and is argued.
As a language, nothing defeats it; as a thesis, an argument that a determination is carried by no relation, and two such arguments are live.

What the checks reach: the work's selectors are the Lean checker, the completion and record checks and the AI reviews; human readers and trained systems couple into none of them, so no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for.

Reading [AI reading, D65], in §6: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

name.en: Institutions and ritual as drive technology

sense.en: Institutions are externalized drive regulation; cultures differ in gain on the same hardware; ritual entrains autonomic states, for compassion and hostility alike. Pre-Qin and Confucian thought has the highest engineering utility. The source says which mechanism acts on which drive is unwritten.

entries.quote: Which Confucian mechanisms, acting on which drives?

reading.en: 06 reads the pre-Qin texts on the spine, on relations and not drives: 礼 in 度量分界, the limit placed between desire and things; 戴震's 以理杀人 as one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in. A rule kept by teaching has one model, nothing about compliance. 05 reads kept promises and enforced contracts as laws giving first, conflict institutions as links of another kind: institutions as regulation, on loops. 07 reads the imperial examination as a counter-rule that became a proxy trap, as read in the meta-attractor line: by descent. So the question is reframed, in part answered in kind. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading: 荀子 "求而无度量分界，则不能不争" and "两者相持而长" fit joint excess and its converse, the limit placed in the relation of desire and things; 戴震 "以理杀人" is one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in, and pooling the affected couplings fills that blindness.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: the forming of concern has several entrances, to be tested side by side; that a rule can be revised and what reaches the rule are two things; counterexamples using the same words must enter the account.

Theorem (root; one family of models): a rule of entry, held by members whose count turns others away, stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure, the quota is at least one and the take fits the renewal. One minimal model; nothing about compliance, nothing normative.

Reading [AI reading, D68] in §6: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the imperial examination is this case, as read in the meta-attractor line: designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. An exchange of harms is a loop, so conflict institutions are links of another kind. On loops, not drives.

Assessment: 248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought set against the spine as agreement, scope or divergence; the relational start holds across lines, universals mostly need scoping, four non-relational layers recur; no new Lean; the classes are AI readings.

account_adds.en: An explicit share of divergence by school, a count of what the grammar cannot express (修 and 心理 among them), and an exact condition for one kind of taught rule.

name.en: What can make sense in a collective is formed

sense.en: Growing up in abundance or scarcity, struggle or peace, makes differences down to which discourse and perspectives can be understood in a collective: the environment-makes-mind thesis extended to the standard of sense. Read as formation, not national character.

entries.quote: down to which discourse and which perspectives can make sense in a collective

reading.en: The account has laws of a shared code: hearing makes no form, the forms that can become shared are those in use, an imposed code costs each formation exactly the distinctions it merges, and a merged distinction returns only from outside or by coining. That is what can be said in a collective, under supplied hearing rules. No law ties it to scarcity or struggle. A neighbour, not a divergence: the free-energy row forbids shared narratives as a guarantee of shared goals, which is about goals, not sense. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: hearing makes no form; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; an imposed code makes all agree, each formation losing exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges; a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Not that actual conventions form by hearing so.

Row: shared generative models give the shared narratives from which shared goals emerge (Friston, Ramstead and others 2024), read as a guarantee, is forbidden for preferences over one's own store, by a witness: holders of one model, each by least risk, can end the renewal they share.

account_adds.en: That imposition's loss falls on all but its source, stated exactly.

source_adds.en: Material conditions as the cause of the difference, and the perspectives a culture can understand rather than forms it holds.

name.en: Ego as generalized territorial drive

sense.en: The ego is the innermost extension of the territorial drive: space, possession, social position, identity, then what reality should be. 'Personal boundaries' is territorial instinct in neutral words; insecurity is the signature of a defended model. Ren asks whether the brain evolved so.

entries.quote: The ego is the innate territorial drive generalized

reading.en: The account's boundary is a region drawn on a course, and "how a center represents the region is unmodelled": it says what a boundary omits, not why one is defended. 01 calls a boundary short of the whole real, relative to its relation, and no further thing beside what it delimits; no instinct is named. "One's own" is a region along a relation no law of the dynamics fixes, read for what concern reaches, not what is guarded. 06 says possession is unrepresented on the spine, 只是未表示，不是相合. So the gradient has no home, and neither does insecurity. [AI reading]
